title: runtime-action-executor: Add ActionExecutor trait + 3 §19 mock actions
description: Feature P0-4. Master §19 (Action ABI) defines the ActionContract (idempotency, side_effect, retry_safety) and ActionId numeric dispatch. vb_runtime/src/action.rs:122-194 has ActionRegistry::dispatch as a stub. The 3 hardcoded CLI specs in vb_cli/src/cli_action_specs.rs:161-191 (validate, write, run) are placeholder names that don't match §19's named action set. engine/action.rs:99-104 errors with CapabilityDenied('__contract_required__') for any contract-less Do. Master §75 (AI-Native CLI Control Plane) requires named actions like github.issue.create in the explain output. This bead: (1) adds `pub trait ActionExecutor: Send + Sync` in vb_runtime/src/action.rs:200+; (2) adds 3 concrete impls in vb_cli/src/cli_action_executors.rs (GithubIssueCreateAction, AiClassifyTicketAction, HttpRequestAction) with their §19 contracts; (3) updates cli_action_specs() to use the §19 names with correct contracts; (4) wires cmd_ipc_serve to construct Arc<MockActionExecutorSet> and pass to Runtime::new_with_journal; (5) adds Kani harness + Verus proof (output taint >= input taint for all 3); (6) adds --executor mock|real flag to cmd_ipc_serve (default mock).

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL execute every ActionId::do_ action through the ActionExecutor trait, not through a hardcoded switch
THE SYSTEM SHALL apply the action's contract (idempotency, side_effect, retry_safety) before, during, and after dispatch

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the runtime dispatches a Do node with action: github.issue.create
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL call GithubIssueCreateAction::execute and return a SlotValue::Object with {id, url, created_at}

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the user passes --executor mock on `vb ipc-serve`
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL construct an Arc<MockActionExecutorSet> with all 3 mock impls and register them in the ActionRegistry

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the user passes --executor real on `vb ipc-serve`
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL construct an Arc<RealActionExecutorSet> and emit a clear error if no real impl is registered for the action (no silent stub fallback)

unwanted.condition: IF a Do node references an ActionId that has no registered executor
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT silently return a default SlotValue::Null; it must return UnknownAction with a clear message
unwanted.because: Master §19 requires explicit action contracts; silent null dispatch hides broken workflows

unwanted.condition: IF a DeterministicPure action receives a non-Clean input taint
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT execute the action; it must return TaintViolation
unwanted.because: Master §65 idempotency gate requires pure actions to never process tainted data

preconditions: ActionExecutor implementation is registered in the ActionRegistry for the requested ActionId
ActionInput.taint satisfies the action's idempotency contract (DeterministicPure requires Clean; others permit all)
postconditions: ActionOutcome is returned with output SlotValue, output taint, and elapsed time
If action declares side_effect: ExternalWrite, a journal ActionCompleted event is appended BEFORE the SlotValue is materialized to the run frame
invariants: Output taint >= input taint (output is at least as restrictive as input)
AtLeastOnceExternal actions upgrade Secret input taint to DerivedFromSecret output taint
Every action's contract matches the §19 matrix; mismatches fail the verify-15-gates check (P1-9 depends on this)

happy: github_issue_create_action_returns_object_with_id_url_created_at: execute with input 'fix login bug' returns {id: 1234, url: 'https://api.github.com/repos/foo/bar/issues/1234', created_at: <now>}
ai_classify_ticket_action_is_deterministic: execute with same input twice returns same label (bug/feature/question)
http_request_action_echoes_url_method_headers: execute with {url, method, headers} returns the same as a SlotValue::List
error: do_node_with_unknown_action_returns_unknown_action: a workflow using action: nonexistent.action fails with UnknownAction at runtime
deterministic_pure_with_secret_taint_returns_taint_violation: ai.classify_ticket with Secret-tainted input returns TaintViolation before execute() is called
edge: kani_harness_proves_output_taint_ge_input_taint: 100 random inputs across all 3 actions, output taint >= input taint
verus_proof_output_taint_ge_input_taint: spec fn taint_ge covers all 3 actions

files: crates/vb_runtime/src/action.rs:200+ (where the new ActionExecutor trait goes)
crates/vb_cli/src/cli_action_specs.rs:161-191 (3 hardcoded placeholder names: validate, write, run)
crates/vb_runtime/src/runtime/mod.rs (Runtime::new_with_journal signature, where the executor is plumbed in)
patterns: Pattern: existing trait Send + Sync in vb_runtime (e.g., ShardCommandSink, ActionTicketSink)
Pattern: cli_action_specs() is called at startup; rebuild it with the §19 names
Pattern: Arc<T> for shared executors across shards
questions: Should the real executor set be a no-op for now (returning NotImplemented), or completely absent (--executor real is rejected with a clear error)? (Spec: absent; real set is a future-bead scope.)
Is the Kani harness for `execute()` with a fuzzer-generated input, or for the contract-check function? (Spec: harness covers contract check; see kani section.)

security_failures.failure: A mock executor leaks the input secret into the output SlotValue, violating output taint >= input taint
security_failures.prevention: Kani harness + Verus proof on the contract check; mock impls must propagate taint, not strip it

security_failures.failure: ActionExecutor::execute is called with a Secret-tainted input on a DeterministicPure action, leaking the secret to the action's external side effect
security_failures.prevention: Contract check is upstream of execute(); TaintViolation is returned before any IO

usability_failures.failure: Operator can't tell which executor (mock or real) is currently registered for each action
usability_failures.prevention: vb action list and vb action inspect commands show the executor set and contract per ActionId

data_integrity_failures.failure: A mock executor returns the same hardcoded id (1234) for every invocation, breaking idempotency_key uniqueness
data_integrity_failures.prevention: GithubIssueCreateAction::execute derives the id from a hash of the input + idempotency_key, not from a constant
data_integrity_failures.test_for_it: github_issue_create_idempotent_for_same_key (same idempotency_key -> same id; different key -> different id)

integration_failures.failure: Runtime::new_with_journal requires an executor set, but tests forget to construct one, causing a runtime panic
integration_failures.prevention: Provide a MockActionExecutorSet::default() that registers all 3 mocks; tests can use this without ceremony

phase_1: Write Kani harness test_action_executor_output_taint_ge_input_taint (100 unwind, 3 actions, Arbitrary inputs)
Write Verus proof `proof fn action_executor_taint_ge(...)` in verification/verus/runtime/
phase_2: In vb_runtime/src/action.rs:200+, add `pub trait ActionExecutor: Send + Sync { fn execute(&self, input: &ActionInput, contract: &ActionContract) -> Result<ActionOutcome, ActionError>; }`
Create crates/vb_cli/src/cli_action_executors.rs with GithubIssueCreateAction, AiClassifyTicketAction, HttpRequestAction
In cli_action_specs.rs, replace the 3 placeholder names with the §19 names: github.issue.create, ai.classify_ticket, http.request
In vb_runtime/src/engine/action.rs:99-104, replace the CapabilityDenied stub with a real call to the registered executor
In Runtime::new_with_journal, accept an `executor: Arc<dyn ActionExecutorSet>` parameter
In cmd_ipc_serve, add --executor flag (default mock); construct Arc<MockActionExecutorSet> when mock
phase_3: Wire Runtime::new() to default to MockActionExecutorSet when no executor is passed (back-compat for existing tests)
phase_4: Run `moon run :test -p vb_cli -p vb_runtime` and verify all new tests pass
Run `cargo kani -p vb_runtime --harness action_executor_output_taint_ge` and verify the proof
Manual: `vb run workflow_with_github_issue.yaml --durability none` should print the mocked {id, url, created_at} object

similar_implementations: See existing ActionContract in vb_core/src/action.rs for the contract enum definitions
external_references: Master §19 Action ABI (full contract enum + matrix)
Master §75 AI-Native CLI Control Plane (github.issue.create in explain output)

apis_that_exist: ActionContract { idempotency: Idempotency, side_effect: SideEffect, retry_safety: RetrySafety } in vb_core/src/action.rs
ActionInput { value: SlotValue, taint: Taint, idempotency_key: Option<u128> }
ActionOutcome { output: SlotValue, output_taint: Taint, elapsed: Duration }
apis_that_do_not_exist: There is no ActionExecutor trait today; this bead adds it
There is no MockActionExecutorSet; this bead adds it
no_placeholder_values: Do NOT use a hardcoded `1234` as the github issue id; derive from a hash of the idempotency_key
Do NOT use 'bug'/'feature'/'question' as random; derive deterministically from a hash of the input text
